title: SKE Crystal Plus Blue Razz Cherry Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Blue Razz Cherry flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods deliver a deliciously tangy and sweet fusion of iconic, juicy blue raspberry and rich cherries. The sharp, syrupy-sweet notes of blue raspberry are perfectly balanced with the deep, ruby sweetness of ripe cherries, offering a satisfyingly bold and fruity vape. Designed exclusively for the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods offer exceptional flavour without any of the hassle. Sharing the iconic crystalline design of the popular SKE Crystal Bars, they provide a sustainable, mess-free alternative to disposable vapes while maintaining the same vibrant flavour experience. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to traditional e-liquids. Paired with the integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil, these pods produce bold flavour and a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience. With no need for refills or coil replacements, the SKE Crystal Plus pods are the perfect choice for vapers who value both flavour and convenience. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
